10pub(crate) fn fill_path<'a>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, fill_rule: FillRule) {
11    fill_path_impl(context, device, fill_rule, None);
12    apply_pending_clip(context, device);
13
14    context.path_mut().truncate(0);
15}

20

24pub(crate) fn fill_stroke_path<'a>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, fill_rule: FillRule) {
25    with_fill_stroke_group(context, device, |context, device| {
26        fill_path_impl(context, device, fill_rule, None);
27        stroke_path_impl(context, device, None);
28    });
29    apply_pending_clip(context, device);
30
31    context.path_mut().truncate(0);
32}

34/// PdfCraft patch: when one operator both fills and strokes a path (`B`, `B*`, `b`, `b*`) or
35/// paints a glyph in text rendering mode 2 or 6, the fill and stroke form an implicit
36/// non-isolated knockout transparency group that is composited as a unit with the current
37/// soft mask and blend mode (ISO 32000-2 §11.7.4.4).
38pub(crate) fn with_fill_stroke_group<'a, D: Device<'a>>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut D, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Context<'a>, &mut D)) {
39    let gs = &context.get().graphics_state;
40    let has_pattern = gs.stroke_cs.is_pattern() || gs.stroke_pattern.is_some() || gs.none_stroke_cs.is_pattern() || gs.non_stroke_pattern.is_some();
41    let needs_group = context.ocg_state.is_visible()
42        && !device.in_knockout_group()
43        && (gs.stroke_alpha < 1.0 || gs.non_stroke_alpha < 1.0 || gs.soft_mask.is_some() || gs.blend_mode != BlendMode::Normal || has_pattern);
44
45    if !needs_group {
46        f(context, device);
47        return;
48    }
49
50    let soft_mask = context.get_mut().graphics_state.soft_mask.take();
51    let blend_mode = std::mem::replace(&mut context.get_mut().graphics_state.blend_mode, BlendMode::Normal);
52
53    device.set_soft_mask(None);
54    device.push_transparency_group(1.0, soft_mask.clone(), blend_mode);
55    device.set_knockout();
56    device.set_blend_mode(BlendMode::Normal);
57
58    f(context, device);
59
60    device.pop_transparency_group();
61    context.get_mut().graphics_state.soft_mask = soft_mask.clone();
62    context.get_mut().graphics_state.blend_mode = blend_mode;
63    device.set_soft_mask(soft_mask);
64    device.set_blend_mode(blend_mode);
65}

67/// PdfCraft patch: a clip set by `W` / `W*` takes effect once the path-painting operator that
68/// ends the path has painted it, whichever operator that is (ISO 32000-2 §8.5.4). Upstream
69/// applied it only on `n`, and otherwise left it pending for some later, unrelated `n`.
70pub(crate) fn apply_pending_clip<'a>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
71    if let Some(rule) = context.clip_mut().take()
72        && !context.path().elements().is_empty()
73    {
74        let ctm = context.get().ctm;
75        // PdfCraft patch (65): a clip that encloses no area keeps the pixels a fill of it marks
76        // (see `degenerate_fill_area`), as ISO 32000-2 §10.7.4 says of clipping: "the clipping
77        // region consists of the set of pixels that would be included by a fill operation".
78        match degenerate_fill_area(context.path(), ctm) {
79            Some(area) => context.push_clip_path(area, FillRule::NonZero, device),
80            None => {
81                let clip_path = ctm * context.path().clone();
82                context.push_clip_path(clip_path, rule, device);
83            }
84        }
85    }
86}

88/// PdfCraft patch (65): the device-space area a fill marks for a path whose bounding box (user
89/// space) has exactly no width or exactly no height, but not both, under `ctm`: one area per
90/// subpath (see `degenerate_line_area`), kept as separate subpaths of one path, so a gap between
91/// two subpaths on the same line stays unpainted (ISO 32000-2 §10.7.4 marks only the pixels the
92/// shape touches). Every area winds the same way, so the non-zero rule paints their union. `None`
93/// for a path with area, a path that is a point, or one none of whose subpaths is a line: those
94/// paint as before.
95pub(crate) fn degenerate_fill_area(path: &BezPath, ctm: Affine) -> Option<BezPath> {
96    let bbox = path.fast_bounding_box();
97    if (bbox.width() == 0.0) == (bbox.height() == 0.0) {
98        return None;
99    }
100    let mut area = BezPath::new();
101    let mut add = |subpath: &BezPath| {
102        if subpath.elements().is_empty() {
103            return;
104        }
105        let Some(mut corners) = degenerate_line_area(subpath.fast_bounding_box(), ctm) else {
106            return;
107        };
108        // Shoelace: wind every area the same way, so overlapping ones add up under non-zero.
109        let twice_area: f64 = (0..4)
110            .map(|i| {
111                let (p, q) = (corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4]);
112                p.x * q.y - q.x * p.y
113            })
114            .sum();
115        if twice_area < 0.0 {
116            corners.reverse();
117        }
118        area.move_to(corners[0]);
119        for corner in &corners[1..] {
120            area.line_to(*corner);
121        }
122        area.close_path();
123    };
124    let mut subpath = BezPath::new();
125    for el in path.elements() {
126        if matches!(el, PathEl::MoveTo(_)) {
127            add(&subpath);
128            subpath.truncate(0);
129        }
130        subpath.push(*el);
131    }
132    add(&subpath);
133    (!area.elements().is_empty()).then_some(area)
134}

136/// PdfCraft patch (65): the corners of the device-space area a fill marks for one subpath whose
137/// bounding box `bbox` (user space) has exactly no width or exactly no height, but not both,
138/// under `ctm`. ISO 32000-2 §10.7.4 paints "any pixel whose half-open square region intersects
139/// the shape, no matter how small the intersection is", and its example says "A zero-width or
140/// zero-height rectangle paints a line 1 pixel wide". Such a path encloses no area, so the
141/// rasteriser marks nothing: the fill used to fall back to a thinnest-line stroke along the box
142/// (half-covering two rows when the line fell on a pixel boundary), and a clip of it hid
143/// everything painted after it. A box with area, however thin, is not one of these: scaled up it
144/// can cover many pixels.
145///
146/// When the line stays within one device row or column (counting a line less than 1/256 of a
147/// pixel across as lying exactly along the axis, at its middle), the area is the run of whole
148/// pixels it touches, by the half-open rule: from the floor of its low end to the ceiling of its
149/// high end, at least one pixel. Otherwise (a rotated or skewed `ctm` that carries it across
150/// rows and columns) it is a band one device pixel wide centred on the line, like the thinnest
151/// line of §8.4.3.2, so each row or column is marked only where the line runs through it. `None`
152/// for a box with area, a point (both sides zero), a non-finite box, or a `ctm` that collapses
153/// the line to a point.
154fn degenerate_line_area(bbox: Rect, ctm: Affine) -> Option<[Point; 4]> {
155    let flat_x = bbox.width() == 0.0;
156    let flat_y = bbox.height() == 0.0;
157    if flat_x == flat_y {
158        return None;
159    }
160    let a = ctm * Point::new(bbox.x0, bbox.y0);
161    let b = ctm * Point::new(bbox.x1, bbox.y1);
162    if ![a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y].iter().all(|v| v.is_finite()) {
163        return None;
164    }
165    let along = b - a;
166    let length = along.hypot();
167    if !length.is_finite() || length <= 0.0 {
168        return None;
169    }
170    let device = Rect::from_points(a, b);
171    let (x0, x1) = touched_pixels(device.x0, device.x1);
172    let (y0, y1) = touched_pixels(device.y0, device.y1);
173    if x1 - x0 <= 1.0 || y1 - y0 <= 1.0 {
174        return Some([Point::new(x0, y0), Point::new(x1, y0), Point::new(x1, y1), Point::new(x0, y1)]);
175    }
176    let half = Vec2::new(-along.y, along.x) * (0.5 / length);
177    Some([a + half, b + half, b - half, a - half])
178}
179
180/// PdfCraft patch (65): the device pixel boundaries `(first, end)` of the pixels a span `lo..=hi`
181/// (`lo <= hi`, finite) touches along one axis by the half-open rule, at least one pixel. A span
182/// under 1/256 of a pixel is taken at its middle, so a line along a device axis that a CTM's
183/// rounding tilts slightly still marks one row or column.
184fn touched_pixels(lo: f64, hi: f64) -> (f64, f64) {
185    let (lo, hi) = if ((hi - lo) as f32).is_nearly_zero() {
186        let mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2.0;
187        (mid, mid)
188    } else {
189        (lo, hi)
190    };
191    let first = lo.floor();
192    (first, hi.ceil().max(first + 1.0))
193}

195pub(crate) fn close_path(context: &mut Context<'_>) {
196    // This is necessary to prevent artifacts (see for example issue 157),
197    // but it does cause some weird lines (maybe conflation artifacts) in
198    // pdftc_900k_0907.
199    //
200    // PdfCraft patch (61): a path that is a single `m` is closed too. kurbo's `is_empty` counts
201    // only segments, so upstream dropped the `h` of `x y m h`, and the single-point closed
202    // subpath a round cap paints as a dot (ISO 32000-2 §8.5.3.2) became a trailing `m`, which
203    // paints nothing.
204    if context.path().elements().last() != Some(&PathEl::ClosePath) && !context.path().elements().is_empty() {
205        context.path_mut().close_path();
206
207        *(context.last_point_mut()) = *context.sub_path_start();
208    }
209}
210
211/// PdfCraft patch (61): call before appending a segment. ISO 32000-2 §8.5.2.1 (Table 58) says `h`
212/// "terminates the current subpath. Appending another segment to the current path shall begin a
213/// new subpath, even if the new segment begins at the endpoint reached by the h operation." kurbo
214/// takes a segment after a `ClosePath` on from the closed subpath's start without a `MoveTo`, so
215/// `resolve_degenerate_subpaths` saw the closed subpath and a degenerate one after it (`h` then an
216/// `l` to the same point) as one subpath and drew no round dot. A `MoveTo` to the point `h`
217/// reached starts the new subpath.
218pub(crate) fn begin_subpath_after_close(context: &mut Context<'_>) {
219    if context.path().elements().last() == Some(&PathEl::ClosePath) {
220        let p = *context.last_point();
221        *(context.sub_path_start_mut()) = p;
222        context.path_mut().move_to(p);
223    }
224}

226pub(crate) fn fill_path_impl<'a>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, fill_rule: FillRule, path: Option<&BezPath>) {
227    if !context.ocg_state.is_visible() {
228        return;
229    }
230
231    let base_transform = context.get().ctm;
232
233    let paint = get_paint(context, false);
234    device.set_soft_mask(context.get().graphics_state.soft_mask.clone());
235    device.set_blend_mode(context.get().graphics_state.blend_mode);
236
237    let mut draw = |path: &BezPath| {
238        // pdf.js issue 4260: Replace zero-sized paths with a small stroke instead.
239        let bbox = path.fast_bounding_box();
240
241        // PdfCraft patch (65): see `degenerate_fill_area`. Painted with the non-zero rule: the
242        // area is one simple shape, whatever rule the path was filled with.
243        if let Some(area) = degenerate_fill_area(path, base_transform) {
244            let draw_mode = PathDrawMode::Fill(FillRule::NonZero);
245            if let Some(rect) = path_as_rect(&area) {
246                device.draw_rect(&rect, Affine::IDENTITY, &paint, &draw_mode);
247            } else {
248                device.draw_path(&area, Affine::IDENTITY, &paint, &draw_mode);
249            }
250            return;
251        }
252
253        // PdfCraft patch (65): only a box with exactly no width or height (by now a point) is
254        // stroked. A box with area, however thin, is filled as the shape it is: a "nearly zero"
255        // side scaled up by the CTM can cover many device pixels.
256        match (bbox.width() == 0.0, bbox.height() == 0.0) {
257            (false, false) => {
258                let draw_mode = PathDrawMode::Fill(fill_rule);
259                if let Some(rect) = path_as_rect(path) {
260                    device.draw_rect(&rect, base_transform, &paint, &draw_mode);
261                } else {
262                    device.draw_path(path, base_transform, &paint, &draw_mode);
263                }
264            }
265            _ => {
266                let mut path = BezPath::new();
267                path.move_to((bbox.x0, bbox.y0));
268                path.line_to((bbox.x1, bbox.y1));
269
270                let stroke_props = StrokeProps {
271                    // TODO: Make dependent on transform?
272                    line_width: 0.001,
273                    line_join: Join::Bevel,
274                    line_cap: Cap::Butt,
275                    ..Default::default()
276                };
277
278                device.draw_path(&path, base_transform, &paint, &PathDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props));
279            }
280        };
281    };
282
283    match path {
284        None => draw(context.path()),
285        Some(path) => draw(path),
286    };
287}

289pub(crate) fn stroke_path_impl<'a>(context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>, path: Option<&BezPath>) {
290    if !context.ocg_state.is_visible() {
291        return;
292    }
293
294    let base_transform = context.get().ctm;
295
296    let stroke_props = context.stroke_props();
297    device.set_soft_mask(context.get().graphics_state.soft_mask.clone());
298    device.set_blend_mode(context.get().graphics_state.blend_mode);
299    let paint = get_paint(context, true);
300
301    // PdfCraft patch (61): see `resolve_degenerate_subpaths`.
302    let path = resolve_degenerate_subpaths(path.unwrap_or(context.path()), stroke_props.line_cap, stroke_props.line_width);
303    let path = path.as_ref();
304    if path.elements().is_empty() {
305        return;
306    }
307    let draw_mode = PathDrawMode::Stroke(stroke_props);
308
309    if let Some(rect) = path_as_rect(path) {
310        device.draw_rect(&rect, base_transform, &paint, &draw_mode);
311    } else {
312        device.draw_path(path, base_transform, &paint, &draw_mode);
313    }
314}

316/// PdfCraft patch (61): `path` as `S` strokes it, by ISO 32000-2 §8.5.3.2: "If a subpath is
317/// degenerate (consists of a single-point closed path or of two or more points at the same
318/// coordinates), the S operator shall paint it only if round line caps have been specified,
319/// producing a filled circle centred at the single point." With butt or projecting square caps
320/// it "shall produce no output". So with round caps a degenerate subpath becomes a segment
321/// centred on its point, a thousandth of the line width long (kurbo draws no cap on a segment of
322/// length zero), and is left out for the other caps. The other subpaths, and zero-length dashes
323/// of them, are not touched. Borrowed when nothing changes.
324pub(crate) fn resolve_degenerate_subpaths(path: &BezPath, cap: Cap, line_width: f32) -> Cow<'_, BezPath> {
325    let elements = path.elements();
326    if !subpaths(elements).any(|sub| degenerate_point(sub).is_some()) {
327        return Cow::Borrowed(path);
328    }
329    let mut out = BezPath::new();
330    for sub in subpaths(elements) {
331        match degenerate_point(sub) {
332            Some(p) if cap == Cap::Round => {
333                // A hairline (width 0) is widened by the device, so it keeps a length kurbo still
334                // caps; an enormous width keeps the segment within half a unit.
335                let half = (f64::from(line_width) * 5e-4).max(5e-5).min(0.5);
336                out.move_to((p.x - half, p.y));
337                out.line_to((p.x + half, p.y));
338            }
339            Some(_) => {}
340            None => sub.iter().for_each(|el| out.push(*el)),
341        }
342    }
343    Cow::Owned(out)
344}
345
346/// The subpaths of `elements`: each starts at a `MoveTo`, except perhaps the first.
347fn subpaths(elements: &[PathEl]) -> impl Iterator<Item = &[PathEl]> {
348    let mut rest = elements;
349    std::iter::from_fn(move || {
350        if rest.is_empty() {
351            return None;
352        }
353        let end = rest.iter().skip(1).position(|el| matches!(el, PathEl::MoveTo(_))).map_or(rest.len(), |i| i.saturating_add(1));
354        let (sub, tail) = rest.split_at_checked(end).unwrap_or((rest, &[]));
355        rest = tail;
356        Some(sub)
357    })
358}
359
360/// The point a degenerate subpath stays at: one that starts with a `MoveTo` and has at least one
361/// segment or a `ClosePath`, every point of which (control points too) is the start point. A lone
362/// `MoveTo` (a trailing `m`) is not one: it paints nothing whatever the caps.
363fn degenerate_point(sub: &[PathEl]) -> Option<Point> {
364    let (PathEl::MoveTo(start), rest) = sub.split_first()? else {
365        return None;
366    };
367    let at = |p: &Point| p == start;
368    let degenerate = !rest.is_empty()
369        && rest.iter().all(|el| match el {
370            PathEl::MoveTo(p) | PathEl::LineTo(p) => at(p),
371            PathEl::QuadTo(a, b) => at(a) && at(b),
372            PathEl::CurveTo(a, b, c) => at(a) && at(b) && at(c),
373            PathEl::ClosePath => true,
374        });
375    degenerate.then_some(*start)
376}

378pub(crate) fn get_paint<'a>(context: &Context<'a>, is_stroke: bool) -> Paint<'a> {
379    let data = if is_stroke { context.get().stroke_data() } else { context.get().non_stroke_data() };
380
381    if data.color_space.is_pattern() || data.pattern.is_some() {
382        if let Some(mut pattern) = data.pattern {
383            if let Some(tf) = &data.transfer_function {
384                pattern.set_transfer_function(tf.clone());
385            }
386
387            // PdfCraft patch: `CA`/`ca` can be set by a `gs` after the pattern colour operator, so use the alpha current at paint time.
388            pattern.set_alpha(data.alpha);
389            pattern.pre_concat_transform(context.root_transform());
390
391            Paint::Pattern(Box::new(pattern))
392        } else {
393            // Pattern was likely invalid, use transparent paint.
394            Paint::Color(Color::new(ColorSpace::device_gray(), smallvec![0.0], 0.0))
395        }
396    } else {
397        // PdfCraft patch (63): see `Context::luminosity_in_device_cmyk`.
398        let color = if context.luminosity_in_device_cmyk && data.color_space.is_device_cmyk() {
399            let gray = device_cmyk_to_gray(&data.color);
400            Color::new(ColorSpace::device_gray(), smallvec![gray], data.alpha)
401        } else {
402            Color::new(data.color_space, data.color, data.alpha)
403        };
404
405        if let Some(tf) = &data.transfer_function { Paint::Color(Color::from_rgba(tf.apply(&color.to_rgba()))) } else { Paint::Color(color) }
406    }
407}
